standard: GDD rework v2 · 80+ researched scenarios · scorecard-passed
note: Caring for your body: washing, brushing & healthy habits (UNESCO 6.5, 6.1). Retrofit of the v1 library (was 44% single-mechanic) to v2. Builds on g02. Step-sequencing is 'build' (mode: sequence).

categories.everyone: Hygiene is for everyone (and not gross)

evidenceBase: Handwashing with soap is one of the most effective ways to prevent illness; sequencing and repetition build the habit early
Ages 3-6 learn routines through doing/sequencing, sorting and voice, audio-first matters for non-readers (Razia/Kabir)
Hygiene is for every body and gender; framing it as normal and empowering (not gross or shameful) builds lifelong habits

scenarios.hook: Clean Crew, assemble! Put the handwashing steps in order.
scenarios.prompt: Drag the steps into the right order.
pieces: scrub all over (sing a little song!)
key: scrub all over (sing a little song!)
scenarios.relearn: Wet, soap, scrub, rinse, dry, that's how clean hands are done.

scenarios.hook: "If my hands LOOK clean, I don't need to wash."

myth.un: If hands look clean, they don't need washing.
myth.re: Germs are too tiny to see; wash anyway.
myth.why: Clean-looking hands can still carry germs.

scenarios.relearn: Germs are invisible; wash even when hands look clean.

scenarios.hook: Sort: a time to wash your hands, or not needed?
scenarios.relearn: Wash before eating, after the toilet, and after playing outside.

scenarios.hook: You're about to eat with dusty hands.
scenarios.relearn: Washing before you eat keeps germs out of your tummy.

scenarios.hook: Match the tool to the job.
scenarios.relearn: Soap, water and a towel are your handwashing helpers.

scenarios.hook: A friend skips washing after the toilet because they're in a hurry.

options.text: Say "come on, quick wash, I'll wait"
options.consequence: You both stay healthier; it takes ten seconds.
Germs spread to your snack and friends.

scenarios.debrief: A quick wash after the toilet stops germs spreading.
scenarios.relearn: Always wash after the toilet, even in a hurry.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: how do freshly-washed hands feel?
scenarios.affirm: Clean hands feel great, and keep you and others well.
scenarios.relearn: Clean hands feel good and keep everyone healthier.

scenarios.hook: Build the perfect hand-scrub. How long do we scrub?
scenarios.prompt: Add the scrub spots so you cover everywhere.
scenarios.relearn: Scrub palms, backs, between fingers, thumbs and nails, all over!

scenarios.hook: "Water alone is enough, you don't need soap."

myth.re: Soap is what lifts germs off; use soap and water.
myth.why: Soap helps germs let go of your skin.

scenarios.relearn: Use soap, not just water, to wash germs away.

scenarios.hook: Your little cousin doesn't know how to wash properly.

yourLine.text: "Wet, soap, scrub, rinse, dry, like this!"

scenarios.relearn: Sharing the steps helps a friend join the Clean Crew.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: washing hands is a tiny habit with a big job. Agree?
scenarios.affirm: Yes, this tiny habit is one of the best ways to stay healthy.
scenarios.relearn: Handwashing is a small habit that does a big job.

scenarios.hook: Sort: good handwashing, or not quite?

items.text: Scrubbing with soap for a little song

scenarios.relearn: Good washing means soap, a proper scrub, and drying after.

scenarios.hook: Put the tooth-brushing steps in order.
scenarios.relearn: Brush gently all over, top, bottom, front and back.

scenarios.hook: "Brushing once a week is enough."

myth.un: Brushing your teeth once in a while is enough.
myth.re: Brush twice a day, morning and night.
myth.why: Germs build up every day; daily brushing clears them.

scenarios.relearn: Brush twice a day, every day.

scenarios.hook: Match the tooth helper to its job.
scenarios.relearn: A brush and toothpaste keep your teeth strong.

scenarios.hook: Sort: good for teeth, or not so good?
scenarios.relearn: Brushing and water help teeth; sweets all day and no brushing don't.

scenarios.hook: You're sleepy and want to skip brushing tonight.

options.consequence: Your teeth stay clean and strong.
Germs party on your teeth overnight.

scenarios.debrief: Night brushing matters most, germs grow while you sleep.
scenarios.relearn: Brush at night even when you're sleepy.

scenarios.hook: It's brushing time and you can do it yourself now.

yourLine.text: "I can brush my teeth all by myself!"

scenarios.relearn: Brushing yourself is a big-kid Clean Crew skill.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: a fresh, clean mouth feels...?
scenarios.affirm: That fresh feeling means your teeth are happy.
scenarios.relearn: Clean teeth feel fresh and stay strong.

scenarios.hook: "Baby teeth don't matter because they fall out."

myth.un: Baby teeth don't matter, they fall out anyway.
myth.re: Baby teeth matter; keep them healthy and clean.
myth.why: Healthy baby teeth help you eat, talk and grow.

scenarios.relearn: Baby teeth matter too; brush them well.

scenarios.hook: Build your twice-a-day brushing plan.
scenarios.relearn: Morning and night, the two times to brush.

scenarios.hook: Bath time! Put the steps in order.
scenarios.relearn: Wet, soap, scrub, rinse, dry, a happy clean body.

scenarios.hook: "Washing your body is only for girls."

myth.un: Washing and grooming are only for girls.
myth.re: Everyone washes and cares for their body.
myth.why: Clean bodies are for all kids, every gender.

scenarios.relearn: Caring for your body is for everyone.

scenarios.hook: Match the body part to how you keep it clean.
scenarios.relearn: Every part of you has a way to stay fresh and clean.

scenarios.hook: Sort: helps you stay fresh, or not?

items.text: Wearing the same dirty socks for days

scenarios.relearn: Regular washing and clean clothes keep you fresh.

scenarios.hook: You can wash some of yourself now, like a big kid.

yourLine.text: "I can wash myself, with a little help!"

scenarios.relearn: Doing parts of your own washing is a growing-up skill.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: clean, dry and fresh, how does that feel?
scenarios.affirm: Fresh and clean is a lovely way to feel.
scenarios.relearn: Being clean and dry feels good for your body.

scenarios.hook: "Drying off doesn't matter."

myth.un: You don't need to dry off properly.
myth.re: Drying, especially between toes, stops itchy skin.
myth.why: Damp skin can get sore or itchy.

scenarios.relearn: Dry off well, especially between your toes.

scenarios.hook: Match the clean habit to when you do it.
scenarios.relearn: Hair, clothes and nails are all part of body care.

scenarios.hook: Pack a 'staying fresh' kit.
scenarios.prompt: Add what helps you stay clean.
scenarios.relearn: Soap, towel, comb, clean clothes, your fresh-and-clean kit.

scenarios.hook: After the toilet, what's the order?
scenarios.relearn: Use, clean, flush, wash, every single time.

scenarios.hook: "You don't have to wash hands after the toilet if you're quick."

myth.un: If you're quick, you can skip washing after the toilet.
myth.re: Always wash with soap after the toilet, every time.
myth.why: This is when germs spread most.

scenarios.relearn: Always wash after the toilet, no skipping.

scenarios.hook: You need the toilet but feel shy to ask at school.
scenarios.relearn: Asking to use the toilet is normal and okay.

scenarios.hook: Sort: a clean-toilet habit, or not?
scenarios.relearn: Flush and wash, that's the clean-toilet habit.

scenarios.hook: "Talking about toilets and washing is gross and rude."

myth.un: Talking about using the toilet is gross and rude.
myth.re: It's a normal body thing everyone does; it's fine to talk about.
myth.why: Knowing how to stay clean keeps you healthy.

scenarios.relearn: Toilet and washing talk is normal, not shameful.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: everyone uses the toilet, it's just a body thing. Agree?
scenarios.affirm: Yes, it's a normal thing every body does. Nothing to be ashamed of.
scenarios.relearn: Using the toilet is a normal part of having a body.

scenarios.hook: A friend laughs at someone for needing the toilet.

options.text: Say "everyone uses the toilet, it's normal"
options.consequence: The teasing stops; nobody should feel ashamed.
Someone feels ashamed of a normal body need.

scenarios.debrief: Body needs are normal; teasing about them isn't kind.
scenarios.relearn: You can stand up when someone's teased about a body need.

scenarios.hook: Sort: healthy daily habit, or not?
scenarios.relearn: Sleep, water and moving are healthy daily habits.

scenarios.hook: Build a happy-and-healthy day.
scenarios.relearn: Washing, brushing, food, water, play and sleep make a healthy day.

scenarios.hook: "Sleep is a waste of time."

myth.un: Sleep is a waste of time.
myth.re: Sleep helps your body grow and your brain recharge.
myth.why: You grow and learn while you rest.

scenarios.relearn: Good sleep helps you grow and feel great.

scenarios.hook: Match the habit to what it gives you.
scenarios.relearn: Each healthy habit gives your body something good.

scenarios.hook: You're about to sneeze.
scenarios.setup: Be a germ hero. Say (and do):
scenarios.relearn: Covering a sneeze in your elbow stops germs flying.

scenarios.hook: You're having so much fun playing you don't want to stop for water or rest.

options.text: Take a quick water-and-rest break, then play more
options.consequence: You feel better and play longer.

scenarios.debrief: Little breaks for water and rest keep the fun going.
scenarios.relearn: Water and rest breaks help your body keep going.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: which healthy habit do YOU want to grow?
scenarios.affirm: Great pick. Small habits add up to a healthy you.
scenarios.relearn: You can choose a healthy habit to grow.

scenarios.hook: "Germs you can't see can't hurt you."

myth.un: If you can't see germs, they can't hurt you.
myth.re: Tiny germs you can't see can still make you sick.
myth.why: That's why we wash and cover sneezes.

scenarios.relearn: Invisible germs are real; washing keeps them away.

scenarios.hook: Sort: stops germs spreading, or spreads them?

items.text: Wiping a runny nose on your hand then touching things

scenarios.relearn: Covering coughs and washing stop germs; the others spread them.

scenarios.hook: Build your bedtime wind-down.
scenarios.relearn: A calm bedtime routine helps good sleep.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: healthy habits are like caring for your amazing body. Agree?
scenarios.affirm: Yes, healthy habits are a way of caring for your amazing body.
scenarios.relearn: Healthy habits are how you care for your body.

scenarios.hook: "Only some kids need to keep clean."

myth.un: Only some kids need to wash and keep clean.
myth.re: Every kid, every gender, keeps clean.

scenarios.relearn: Hygiene is for everyone.

scenarios.hook: A friend feels embarrassed about a body-care question.

yourLine.text: "It's normal, everyone looks after their body."

scenarios.relearn: Body-care questions are normal; no need to feel shy.

scenarios.hook: Sort: a Clean Crew habit for everyone, or a silly 'only for some' rule?
scenarios.relearn: Clean habits are for every kid, whatever their gender.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: keeping clean helps you AND the people around you. True?
scenarios.affirm: Yes, your clean habits keep you and your friends healthier.
scenarios.relearn: Staying clean helps you and everyone around you.

scenarios.hook: Your whole crew is heading out to eat after play.

options.consequence: Everyone washes; the whole crew stays well.

options.text: Say nothing and eat with dirty hands

scenarios.debrief: A good Clean Crew member helps the whole team stay healthy.
scenarios.relearn: You can lead your friends in healthy habits.

scenarios.hook: Match each Clean Crew hero to their power.
scenarios.relearn: Each clean habit is a superpower for your health.

scenarios.hook: "Being a bit dirty is cool and washing is babyish."

myth.un: Staying dirty is cool; washing is babyish.
myth.re: Looking after your body is a strong, grown-up thing.
myth.why: Healthy habits help you feel and do your best.

scenarios.relearn: Caring for your body is a grown-up superpower, not babyish.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: you're a Clean Crew hero now. How does that feel?
scenarios.affirm: You've got the habits to keep yourself healthy. Hero status!
scenarios.relearn: You can keep your own body healthy and clean.

scenarios.hook: There's no soap at the tap, just water.

options.text: Wash well with water, and tell a grown-up there's no soap
options.consequence: You do your best and help fix it for everyone.
More germs stay on your hands.

scenarios.debrief: Water helps; soap is better, so let a grown-up know it's out.
scenarios.relearn: Wash with what you have, and ask for soap to be refilled.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: who can remind your family it's brushing time?
scenarios.affirm: You can be the one who keeps the whole family brushing. Hero!
scenarios.relearn: You can help your whole family keep healthy habits.

scenarios.hook: "You only need to wash when you're visibly dirty."

myth.un: You only wash when you can see dirt.
myth.re: Regular washing keeps you fresh even without visible dirt.
myth.why: Sweat and germs build up unseen.

scenarios.relearn: Wash regularly, not only when you look dirty.

scenarios.hook: Your hands are dirty and a snack is right there.
scenarios.relearn: Hands-first is a habit worth keeping.

scenarios.hook: Set up the toilet-clean routine for school.
scenarios.relearn: The same clean routine works at school too.

scenarios.hook: Sort: kind about hygiene, or unkind?
scenarios.relearn: Help kindly; never shame someone about hygiene.

scenarios.hook: Match the moment to 'wash now!'
scenarios.relearn: Before eating, after the loo, after play, all wash times.

scenarios.hook: You ran out of toothpaste this morning.

options.text: Brush with water and tell a grown-up to get more
options.consequence: You still clean your teeth and solve the problem.

scenarios.debrief: Brushing with water still helps; ask for more toothpaste.
scenarios.relearn: Do your best to brush, and ask for what's missing.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: a healthy body helps you play, learn and have fun. Worth it?
scenarios.affirm: Your healthy habits power all the fun stuff you love.
scenarios.relearn: Healthy habits power the play and fun you love.

scenarios.hook: You finished a sweaty cricket game.

yourLine.text: "Time to wash up and put on clean clothes!"

scenarios.relearn: Washing after sweaty play keeps you fresh.

scenarios.hook: "Drying on your dirty shirt is the same as a towel."

myth.un: Wiping wet hands on your clothes is fine.
myth.re: Dry on a clean towel; dirty clothes add germs back.
myth.why: A clean dry finish keeps hands clean.

scenarios.relearn: Dry on a clean towel, not dirty clothes.

scenarios.hook: Match the food to what it does to teeth.
scenarios.relearn: Water and fruit are kind to teeth; sweets all day aren't.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: it's okay to tell a grown-up if a toilet isn't clean or safe. True?
scenarios.affirm: Yes, telling a trusted grown-up helps keep places clean and safe.
scenarios.relearn: You can tell a grown-up if a toilet isn't clean or safe.

scenarios.hook: Sort: morning routine, or bedtime routine?
scenarios.relearn: Routines top and tail your day, morning fresh-up and calm bedtime.

scenarios.hook: A new kid doesn't know the class washing routine.

options.text: Show them kindly: "we wash before snack, come on!"
options.consequence: They join in and feel welcome.

options.text: Let them figure it out alone
options.consequence: They feel lost and left out.

scenarios.debrief: Sharing healthy habits kindly helps everyone belong.
scenarios.relearn: You can welcome someone into healthy habits.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: caring for your body shows you value it. Agree?
scenarios.affirm: Caring for your body is a way of valuing the amazing you.
scenarios.relearn: Caring for your body shows you value it (links Body Lab).

scenarios.hook: Lensy: a healthy smile is something to be proud of. Yours?
scenarios.affirm: Keep brushing and your smile stays bright and strong.
scenarios.relearn: Brushing keeps your smile bright and healthy.

scenarios.hook: Teach the handwash song-steps to the Clean Crew.
scenarios.relearn: Wet, soap, scrub, rinse, dry, sing it and never forget!

scenarios.hook: "Healthy food is boring; only treats are good."

myth.un: Only treats taste good; healthy food is boring.
myth.re: Lots of healthy foods are yummy and give you energy.
myth.why: Fruits, dals, veggies can be delicious.

scenarios.relearn: Healthy food can be tasty and gives you energy.

scenarios.hook: Time to rally the Clean Crew one last time.

yourLine.text: "Wash, brush, rest, repeat, go Clean Crew!"

scenarios.relearn: Healthy habits, done every day, make you a Clean Crew hero.

scenarios.hook: Sort: keeps hair & nails healthy, or not?

items.text: Letting nails get long and dirty

scenarios.relearn: Clean hair and trimmed nails are part of body care.

scenarios.hook: You feel like skipping ALL your healthy habits today.

options.text: Do at least the key ones: wash, brush, sleep
options.consequence: You stay healthy even on a lazy day.
You feel grotty and germs build up.

scenarios.debrief: Even on lazy days, the key habits keep you well.
scenarios.relearn: Keep the key habits going, even on lazy days.

scenarios.hook: "Brushing harder cleans better."

myth.un: The harder you brush, the cleaner your teeth.
myth.re: Brush gently; hard scrubbing can hurt your gums.

scenarios.relearn: Brush gently all over, not hard.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: caring for your body is something to be proud of, whoever you are. Agree?
scenarios.affirm: Yes, every kid can be proud of caring for their body.
scenarios.relearn: Caring for your body is for everyone, and worth being proud of.

scenarios.hook: Capstone: build your very own Clean Crew daily plan.
scenarios.relearn: Your own daily plan keeps the amazing you healthy.

scenarios.hook: Lensy: what's your Clean Crew motto?
scenarios.affirm: Carry that. You know how to keep yourself healthy and strong.
scenarios.relearn: Washing, brushing and healthy habits keep your body well, for everyone.
